verses.text: A Song of the Ascents. Of Solomon. If YHWH does not build the house, in vain do its builders labor on it; if YHWH does not guard the city, in vain the one guarding keeps watch.

segments.text: A Song of the Ascents. Of Solomon. If YHWH does not build the house, in vain do its builders labor on it; if YHWH does not guard the city, in vain the one guarding keeps watch.

verses.text: [It is] vain for you⁺, being early [in] rising, [and] delaying to sit, eating the bread of sorrows; for so He gives sleep to His beloved.

segments.text: [It is] vain for you⁺, being early [in] rising, [and] delaying to sit, eating the bread of sorrows; for so He gives sleep to His beloved.

verses.text: Behold, an inheritance of YHWH [are] sons, a reward [is] the fruit of the womb.

segments.text: Behold, an inheritance of YHWH [are] sons, a reward [is] the fruit of the womb.

verses.text: Like arrows in the hand of a mighty one, so [are] the sons of one’s youth.

segments.text: Like arrows in the hand of a mighty one, so [are] the sons of one’s youth.

verses.text: Blessed [is] the man who has filled his quiver with them! He will not be put to shame, but he shall speak with the enemies at the gate.

segments.text: Blessed [is] the man who has filled his quiver with them! He will not be put to shame, but he shall speak with the enemies at the gate.
